# tasks.cell_count_aggregation { #operetta_compose.tasks.cell_count_aggregation }

`tasks.cell_count_aggregation`

Aggregate cell counts per experimental condition across an OME-Zarr plate.

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [aggregate_cell_counts](#operetta_compose.tasks.cell_count_aggregation.aggregate_cell_counts) | Count cells per well (and readout class) and join the experimental conditions. |
| [cell_count_aggregation](#operetta_compose.tasks.cell_count_aggregation.cell_count_aggregation) | Aggregate cell counts per experimental condition across an OME-Zarr plate. |

### aggregate_cell_counts { #operetta_compose.tasks.cell_count_aggregation.aggregate_cell_counts }

```python
tasks.cell_count_aggregation.aggregate_cell_counts(
    feature_df,
    condition_df,
    readout_column=None,
)
```

Count cells per well (and readout class) and join the experimental conditions.

The counts are computed from the feature table and joined onto the condition
table so that every condition well is represented in the output even when no
cell was measured for it. When ``readout_column`` is given, each condition
well is reported against every observed readout category, so missing
combinations (a well/category pair with no measured cells) appear explicitly
with a count of 0 rather than being absent.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                                                               | Default    |
|----------------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| feature_df     | pd.DataFrame | Concatenated feature table with at least the columns ``row`` and ``column`` (added by ``concatenate_image_tables``).                                                                      | _required_ |
| condition_df   | pd.DataFrame | Concatenated condition table with at least the columns ``row`` and ``column``.                                                                                                            | _required_ |
| readout_column | str \| None  | Optional column in the feature table used to break the counts down further (e.g. a classifier prediction like viable/dead). When ``None``, the total number of cells per well is counted. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                             |
|--------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | A long-format dataframe with one row per condition well (and readout    |
|        | pd.DataFrame | class), the experimental condition columns and a ``cell_count`` column. |

### cell_count_aggregation { #operetta_compose.tasks.cell_count_aggregation.cell_count_aggregation }

```python
tasks.cell_count_aggregation.cell_count_aggregation(
    zarr_urls,
    zarr_dir,
    feature_table_name='regionprops',
    condition_table_name='condition',
    readout_column=None,
    output_table_name='cell_counts',
    table_backend='parquet',
    overwrite=True,
)
```

Aggregate cell counts per experimental condition across an OME-Zarr plate.

This task reads the per-image feature and condition tables of a whole plate,
counts the number of cells per well (optionally broken down by a readout
column such as a classifier prediction), joins the experimental conditions
and writes the aggregated counts back as a plate-level table.

It is resilient to conditions for which no cell was measured: every well
present in the condition table appears in the output with a ``cell_count``
of 0 in that case.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                 | Type                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                            | Default         |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------|
| zarr_urls            | list\[str\]                                            | List of paths to the OME-Zarr images of the plate (provided by Fractal for a non-parallel task).                                                                                                       | _required_      |
| zarr_dir             | str                                                    | Path to the directory containing the plate (provided by Fractal).                                                                                                                                      | _required_      |
| feature_table_name   | str                                                    | Name of the per-image feature table to aggregate.                                                                                                                                                      | `'regionprops'` |
| condition_table_name | str                                                    | Name of the plate-level condition table to join (written by the `condition_registration` task).                                                                                                        | `'condition'`   |
| readout_column       | str \| None                                            | Optional column in the feature table to break the counts down by (e.g. a classifier prediction). Counts total cells per well when left unset.                                                          | `None`          |
| output_table_name    | str                                                    | Name of the plate-level table to write.                                                                                                                                                                | `'cell_counts'` |
| table_backend        | Literal\[\'anndata\', \'json\', \'csv\', \'parquet\'\] | ngio table backend used to store the output table. ``parquet`` is a compact columnar default; ``csv`` keeps the table human-readable inside the OME-Zarr; ``anndata`` and ``json`` are also supported. | `'parquet'`     |
| overwrite            | bool                                                   | Whether to overwrite an existing output table.                                                                                                                                                         | `True`          |
